summary: All six P12b carriers are migrated, pushed and done. SSEGateway 41cf1b5 (four deploy repos Healthy at their pins) and MyDownloadsClient fc6c74b (media-prd and webathome-org-prd rolled) were pushed alone, and every AaC build is green with arch-validate run from aac-tools. D5's FieldnotesApp rebuild did not run: the operator's push 97777d7, a descendant of 1ee1929, had already built green as #41, and fieldnotes-prd rolled its pin (close-out N8).
